decision: V1.1.0 RELEASE READY WITH KNOWN RESEARCH VARIANCE
variance_audit_conclusion: The final-candidate smoke's zero-evidence result is live research variance. No configuration regression, correctness bug, or confirmed P0 was found. The no-evidence report refusal is the expected invariant.
publication_state_authority: Remote Git tag and hosting release metadata
supersedes: Pre-candidate gate snapshot at commit 3201b7c8457f6163586751d0b7e5a080c54967d9; its dirty-tree, migration and stale-SOURCE_REVISION blockers were resolved by the clean candidate evidence below.

version_metadata_correction.note: The metadata-only release commit 36c920f58196a258dbcc215f5f76aec9a0582243 is based on validated pre-release base 466eefd301a6dfa24e39b58d0cf50a1b8c59a037. Runtime was rebuilt from the clean candidate; final success-path smoke failed without Accepted Evidence.

release_file_audit.evidence: 166 explicitly allow-listed release files committed; local, temporary and historical items were excluded or preserved, not mass-added or deleted.

research_intelligence_frozen.evidence: No Research Intelligence behavior was changed for reproducibility closeout.

configuration_frozen.evidence: Frozen values resolved on API and Worker: evidence_aware_context=false, independent_source_targeting=true, evidence_input_quality=false. Run stamps candidate SHA and standard tier, but omits reference_config_id and per-run flag snapshot.

pytest.evidence: pytest -q passed; 7 existing opt-in integration tests were skipped; warnings were non-failing.

mypy_api.evidence: mypy apps/api/app passed for 173 source files.

mypy_release_scripts.evidence: Four maintained Phase 17/release scripts passed MyPy. Historical scripts/correct_phase15_2_comparability.py was excluded because it has 3 pre-existing MyPy errors and is not in the release source allowlist.

diff_check.evidence: git diff --check passed; line-ending warnings only.

secret_scan.evidence: No high-confidence credential patterns in allow-listed release files; local .env and artifacts/.secrets remain excluded and were not exposed.

migration.evidence: 0024 and 0025 are in candidate commit; single Alembic head 20260918_0025. A disposable database upgraded from 0023 through head and verified expected schema; temporary database was dropped.

clean_candidate_docker_build.evidence: No-cache API/Worker/Web images built from the clean candidate worktree; Compose configuration validated.

docker_startup.evidence: API, Worker, Dispatcher, Beat, Postgres, Redis, SearXNG and Web started from candidate; API healthz and readyz passed.

provenance.evidence: API reports version 1.1.0-rc.1 and source revision 36c920f58196a258dbcc215f5f76aec9a0582243; Worker, Dispatcher and Beat Settings resolve to the same full SHA/version; frozen API/Worker flags are false/true/false. The run snapshot includes reference_config_id v1-pre-rc-reference-1 and those flags.

success_path_smoke.evidence: The one fresh standard smoke 01a0cdb6-4548-7d7c-a2c8-e9e86e665896 terminalized with REPORT_NO_ACCEPTED_EVIDENCE after deadline_exhausted; 19 search queries started, 13 completed, 31 readable sources, 15 evidence.extracted events, and zero Candidate/Accepted Evidence. The read-only variance audit found no configuration regression or correctness bug; this remains a live research limitation, not a confirmed P0.

report_persistence_fetch_verification.evidence: No Report row exists for the smoke because Accepted Evidence was 0; application correctly applied REPORT_NO_ACCEPTED_EVIDENCE. Report fetch/verified criteria therefore were not met, but this is not evidence of a broken Report pipeline.

failure_path_no_evidence_invariant.evidence: Run 01a0c9ad-2018-7730-a8ef-1066181f4cc7 had zero accepted evidence, no persisted report, and terminal reason REPORT_NO_ACCEPTED_EVIDENCE.

working_tree.evidence: The verification worktree at candidate SHA is clean. Primary workspace retains only explicitly excluded/preserved local artifacts and one-off files; none are required by the candidate.

no_p0_blocker.evidence: No confirmed P0 was found: migration, clean build/start, provenance, API readiness and Worker execution passed. The smoke's lack of Accepted Evidence is classified as live research variance; report omission correctly preserved the no-fabrication invariant.

accepted_p1: The smoke run does not persist reference_config_id or a per-run feature-flag snapshot; frozen settings were verified against live API and Worker configuration and matched the reference values.
The full release-script MyPy gate excludes one historical, non-allow-listed Phase 15.2 analysis script with 3 pre-existing MyPy errors; maintained release scripts and API source passed.
known_non_blocking_issues: Low-altitude coverage weakness and run variance.
verified_claims=0 limitation and q1 projection inconsistency.
Source-role semantics and Evidence Input Quality optimization remain deferred; experimental flags are disabled.

old_pre_candidate_p0s.uncommitted_migrations_and_runtime_sourc: RESOLVED by candidate commit and explicit 166-file allowlist.
old_pre_candidate_p0s.dirty_tree: RESOLVED for release verification: candidate worktree is clean; primary workspace local/excluded artifacts were preserved and are not candidate dependencies.
old_pre_candidate_p0s.stale_source_revision: RESOLVED: launcher and all runtime services report the candidate SHA.

release_actions.publication_tracking: Remote Git tag and hosting release metadata are authoritative; this gate captures qualification evidence.
